goal: Prevent creating wallets whose names consist entirely of whitespace characters
Avoids confusing or indistinguishable directory paths on the user filesystem
agreement: Substantive support for disallowing whitespace names on wallet creation (achow101)
Clarified no objection after ensuring pre-existing wallets can still be loaded (maflcko)
Suggested disallowing leading and trailing whitespace as well (polespinasa)

categories.name: wallet
why: P4 because whitespace-only wallet creation is a minor edge case with narrow impact
Validates wallet names to prevent confusing directory names on the filesystem
